574-6517-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-6517-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

7084-7892-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4770-5301-6633-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

323-1339-1832-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-1339-1832-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2510-4050-8077-8107.notablePrerequisites: There is an enchantment card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4050-8077-8107.description:
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Semblance Anvil.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3564-4247-4275-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-4247-4275-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
3564-4247-4275-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

575-4247-5971.notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-4247-5971.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing it.
When Bloodthrone Vampire dies, Yedora triggers, returning Bloodthrone Vampire from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Bloodthrone Vampire enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1, doing nothing.
Repeat.
575-4247-5971.notes: You may instead sacrifice a different creature to get the infinite sacrifice outlet products.

851-3129-4365-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-3129-4365-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

5641-6824-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6824-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2024-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W} equal to its power.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Doc Samson and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2024-7704.notes: Alternate which color of mana you add each loop.

3641-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3641-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2525-2921-3763-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2525-2921-3763-6749.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Body Double from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Choose to have Body Double enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Body Double enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-3899-4552-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-3301-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

3693-5220-6900.description:
Cast Walking Ballista either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

589-2275-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-2275-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1796-4484-4871-5643-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-4484-4871-5643-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-4484-4871-5643-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-2364.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Mana Vault.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Mana Vault.
Repeat.

1-5437-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-5437-5796-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

1671-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1671-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Simic Growth Chamber and another land.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

1090-4050-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-4050-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5231-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures, adding {R} for each one.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Repeat from 3.

1322-3519-5696.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1322-3519-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
Activate a Forest Dryad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 3 for each Forest Dryad token created in step 2.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling or tapping the Forest Dryads.

745-1558-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
745-1558-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

527-1636-4077.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 8 or greater.
527-1636-4077.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Wall by paying {4}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Quicksilver Wall by paying {2}{U}.
When Quicksilver Wall enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 9 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

1883-2583-3484.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1883-2583-3484.description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Decoction Module.
Replication Technique's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy Replication Technique, with your copy targeting Decoction Module.
Resolve all Replication Techniques, causing you to create two token copies of Decoction Module.
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, each Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

1347-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1347-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Urabrask's Forge triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1347-3259.notes: As Urabrask's Forge will keep gaining oil counters, the creature token will keep gaining more power, eventually becoming infinitely powerful.

2532-4050-4894.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4050-4894.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Breaching Hippocamp with haste.
The Breaching Hippocamp token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Breaching Hippocamp token, adding {R}.
The Breaching Hippocamp token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1209-2302-4050-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kozilek, adding one mana of any color.
Kozilek and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Kozilek trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Kozilek, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
